# Security Requirements Checklist: User Authentication & Profile

**Purpose**: Validate that the authentication, credential-handling and data-ownership requirements are complete, unambiguous and verifiable before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/user-auth.openapi.yaml](../contracts/user-auth.openapi.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Credential Handling

- [ ] CHK001 Is the password hashing requirement specific enough to exclude weak algorithms without naming a single library? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the minimum password length the only password rule, and is the absence of complexity rules a deliberate, documented choice? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the places where a plaintext password may transit (request body only) and may never appear (storage, logs, responses) all stated? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, §NFR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the maximum accepted password length defined, so oversized inputs cannot be used to exhaust the hashing function? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]

## Token Lifecycle

- [ ] CHK005 Are token lifetime, expiry behaviour and the response for an expired token all stated with the same status and message? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the requirement that the signing secret comes only from environment configuration testable, e.g. does it state what happens when the secret is missing at startup? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the token claims that identify the user specified so that a renamed or re-emailed user keeps a valid token? [Clarity, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the behaviour for a syntactically valid token whose user no longer exists defined as unauthenticated rather than not-found? [Coverage, Spec §US5 scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the decision to exclude logout, refresh and revocation explicit, with the resulting exposure window (up to 24 h after deletion of the token by the client) acknowledged? [Assumption, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Authentication Failures & Enumeration

- [ ] CHK010 Is the "same message for unknown email and wrong password" requirement extended to response timing, so the two paths are not distinguishable by latency? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Are registration conflict messages (email taken, telegram id taken) evaluated against the enumeration risk they create, and is the trade-off documented? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the absence of rate limiting and lockout an explicit accepted risk with an owner and a trigger for revisiting it? [Assumption, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Data Ownership & Isolation

- [ ] CHK013 Is "identity comes only from the bearer token" stated in a way that forbids any user-supplied identifier from influencing which row is read or written? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the fields that are read-only through the profile update endpoint (id, email, password) listed exhaustively? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the cascade-on-delete requirement name every owned table, and is ownership of the cascade declaration assigned to the feature that creates each child table? [Traceability, Spec §FR-012, plan.md]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the required behaviour for concurrent requests during account deletion (no orphaned rows) measurable? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Transport & Cross-Origin

- [ ] CHK017 Are allowed CORS origins a configurable requirement rather than a hard-coded value, and is the production origin list identified? [Gap, plan.md R8]
- [ ] CHK018 Is HTTPS-only transport for tokens stated as a deployment requirement or explicitly delegated to the hosting layer? [Gap]

## Logging & Observability

- [ ] CHK019 Does the logging requirement list what must appear (event, email or user id) and what must never appear (password, hash, token) for each auth event? [Completeness, Spec §NFR-005]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the retention or sensitivity classification of auth logs that contain emails addressed or explicitly deferred? [Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
